Maya - CS: Quick pulse for Vellum Labs — WoW token usage down ~8%, QoQ up ~14%. Avg latency increased ~30ms to ~210ms (p95 up ~60ms). Error rate 0.3% -> 0.95% (spike Wed ~14:30 UTC). Spend +6% WoW. Renewal flag: low risk but they're asking about throughput/cost. Thoughts?

Ravi - Eng: I noticed a canary config change Tue evening — `--max-batch=64` was applied to the canary. That would push up tail latency for mid-size requests. Will check logs.

ops-bot: Deploy @3329875000: service=vellum-gen, actor=ravi-eng, change=config-batch-size=64, target=canary, status=success

Liam - Solutions: For Vellum's prompt distribution, enabling prefix/KV caching should cut served tokens ~10-15% for the common flows. Also recommend trying rdx-mini-q4 on dedicated pool for cost tests (small quality tradeoff).

Jordan - AE: Customer note — they're pleased with output but worried about monthly run rate creeping up. They asked for ops tips and a short performance session before the renewal review.

Maya - CS: Plan: (1) Ravi roll back canary to previous batch size if that correlates with the spike, (2) Liam run a 30-min tuning session with their SRE to demo caching + model variant, (3) Jordan prepare a spend/quality slide for renewal. I'll ping Vellum for times. @Ravi - Eng @Liam - Solutions @Jordan - AE

Ravi - Eng: Rolling canary rollback now (changing `--max-batch` -> 32). ETA ~12m.

ops-bot: Rollback @3329876000: service=vellum-gen, actor=ravi-eng, change=config-batch-size=32, target=canary->stable, status=success

Liam - Solutions: Booked 30-min tune session Thu 10:00 PT, invite sent to vellum-ops+prod@example.com. Will bring perf runbook and sample prompt set; plan to test KV cache -> measure token delta and latency.

Maya - CS: Thanks team. I'll update the account health tile (usage / latency / errors / spend) and mark as monitoring for 48h. Risk: transient; renewal posture remains medium->green if tune goes well. :thumbsup:

Jordan - AE: I'll add a small cost-savings scenario to the renewal deck showing cache + q4 variant impact (est. -12% tokens, -6% spend).

Maya - CS: Closing loop here — will post follow-up snapshot next Monday. If anyone sees new spikes, drop them in this thread.
